_doc: Wave 8 reference cameras (tools/refcams/README.md), the same format as cameras.json and cameras_w7.json. One row a camera, each on its own line. Run with REFCAMS_JSON=tools/refcams/cameras_w8.json.

cameras.name: gas_station_night
cameras.label: A roadside gas station at 23:30 clear, eye level from across the street over the forecourt: the lit canopy, the pumps, a car at a pump, the store window, the empty street

cameras.name: hill_home_dusk
cameras.label: A cantilever hill home's pool deck on the front range (estate 392, 159 m up) at 19:15 clear, looking south over the basin: the infinity pool, the glass wall lit inside, downtown's lights below

cameras.name: skate_park
cameras.label: THE PIT at 16:30 clear, eye level on the high deck by the pool, a skater mid-air over the far coping, the boardwalk and its palms behind

cameras.name: storm_downtown
cameras.label: A thunderstorm at 20:30 on Flower St just south of 8th, looking north up the street to the towers: rain sheets, a held lightning strike, the soaked street mirroring the lit towers and signals, traffic with wipers and spray

cameras.name: arena_night
cameras.label: STARLIGHT PLAZA on an event night at 21:00 clear, eye level in the crowd looking north-west: the screen wall, the theatre's lobby, the hotel's lit crown, searchlights

cameras.name: speedboat_golden
cameras.label: The SALTRUNNER at speed off the beach town at 17:45 clear, a chase view into the sun path, the Palos Verdes headland on the left

cameras.name: jet_takeoff
cameras.label: An airliner rotating off 27R at 19:15 clear, from the grass between the runways beside 27R's departure (west) end and an edge light, looking east-north-east: the jet lifting off, the concourse, the tower and the skyhook behind

cameras.name: farmers_market
cameras.label: Palm St's farmers' market on a Saturday at 10:00 clear, eye level in the aisle between the two rows of canopies: produce, shoppers, stallholders

cameras.name: police_pursuit
cameras.label: Police pursuit at 22:00 clear: the chase camera behind the player's car east on Wilshire, two cruisers on his tail with their bars going, the helicopter's searchlight on him

cameras.name: brush_fire
cameras.label: A Santa Ana evening at 18:30 on Elm Blvd at 7th St in midtown, looking north up the boulevard at the brush fire on the front range: the smoke column laid over by the wind, its glow, the dusty sky, litter blowing

cameras.name: construction_dusk
cameras.label: A downtown tower going up at 18:45 clear, from the pavement across the street from its hoarding: the crane and its red lamps, the open slabs under the netting, the hoist, the crew at the gate

cameras.name: wingsuit_golden
cameras.label: The hero in his wingsuit at 18:00 clear, from his chase camera 6 m behind, gliding ~120 m over Bunker Hill toward the downtown skyline

cameras.name: rail_crossing
cameras.label: A Coral Line level crossing on River Blvd at Harbor Blvd at 17:30 clear, bonnet height in the first car of the southbound queue: the gates down, the flashers going, a train crossing west, the queue in the next lane and across the tracks

cameras.name: cemetery_dawn
cameras.label: HOLLYCREST MEMORIAL PARK at 06:30 under the marine layer, eye level among the stones on the rise looking east up the lawn to the mausoleum on the crown: mist, wet grass, cypresses, the drive's lanterns going out

cameras.name: suburb_night
cameras.label: A suburban street in the valley at 21:30 clear, on the pavement looking east: lit rooms and TVs, porch lights, lawns, parked cars, the street lamps

cameras.name: fireworks_ballpark
cameras.label: A fireworks show over SUNRIDGE BALLPARK at 21:30 clear, from Stadium Way above the south lots looking north-west, a big peony 0.9 s after its break between two hanging willows, three shells rising: shells breaking over centre field, the smoke lit by the breaks, the lit stadium and its lots below

cameras.name: taco_truck_night
cameras.label: A taco truck at the kerb in midtown at 23:00 clear, eye level in its queue on the pavement: the lit menu board and serving window, the cook, customers waiting, the generator, the empty street beyond

cameras.name: port_gate
cameras.label: The container terminal's truck gate at 10:00 clear, eye level by the west booth island looking east along the booth row under the canopy: drayage semis at the booths and queued under the OCR portal, the barriers, the stacks behind

cameras.name: rush_hour
cameras.label: The 105 at 17:40 clear from a caged footbridge east of the 110, looking west down the carriageways into the low sun: the evening rush, brake lights, the gantries

cameras.name: oil_islands_dusk
cameras.label: The decorated oil islands from the Long Beach sand at 18:45 clear, looking west-south-west down the bay: the gelled towers and palms against the afterglow, the bay, the port cranes behind

cameras.name: power_plant_dusk
cameras.label: The coastal power plant at 18:50 clear from the wet sand to its north: the twin stacks and their aviation lights, the turbine hall, the transmission line leaving inland, the surf on the right

cameras.name: lighthouse_night
cameras.label: Gull Point light at 22:00 clear from the breakwater's armour stones, looking north-west over the harbour: the lighthouse on the headland, its beam sweeping out over the water, the port's cranes and the refinery's flares across the harbour

cameras.name: auto_row
cameras.label: A new-car dealership (VELMARA) on the midtown auto row at 11:00 clear, from the kerb at the lot's south end looking north-east: the lot's rows of cars nose-out with window stickers, the tube men and pennants, the glass showroom under its red portal, the brand pylon

cameras.name: walk_of_fame_night
cameras.label: The walk of fame (Canyon Blvd) at 22:00 clear, eye level on the south pavement over the terrazzo stars looking west to THE GRAND CELESTE's lit marquee: the lamps' neon star medallions, the souvenir fronts, costumed characters, the crowd

cameras.name: driver_rain
cameras.label: From just behind the driver's head in the player's own car, stopped second at a red on Grand Ave at 22:00 in rain: the dash glow, the beaded windscreen and its wipers, the brake and signal lights smeared in the wet street

cameras.name: backyard_pool
cameras.label: A valley suburb back yard on a Saturday at 15:00 clear, from the patio over the pool south toward the front range: loungers with sunbathers, citrus trees, the back fence, the neighbours' roofs

cameras.name: crash_closeup
cameras.label: A sedan wrapped round a bent street lamp on Cedar Ave, midtown, at 13:00 clear, from the pavement at arm's length: the crushed bonnet, the airbags, the glass on the road, onlookers filming

cameras.name: friday_lights
cameras.label: Harbor Crest High's stadium on a game night at 20:00 clear, from the north-east corner of its car park over the lot's low wall: a parked car, people walking in past a hot dog cart, the lit field and its players, the home stands, the light standards

cameras.name: googie_motel
cameras.label: A Googie motel on Highland Blvd in midtown at 21:00 clear, from the parking lane across the boulevard: the pole sign's chasing bulbs and VACANCY box, the motor court's room doors and parked cars, the boulevard's traffic

cameras.name: rail_aerial
cameras.label: The Coral Line's aerial structure where it swings off Flower over the 110, from River Blvd below at 20:00 clear, looking west: a lit train on the box girder's curve, the columns and hammerheads, the overhead wires against the sky, the 110's deck and traffic

cameras.name: sea_life
cameras.label: Life in the water at 08:00 clear from the round head of the straight pier, looking south-east down the coast: a dolphin pod arcing beyond the break, a line of pelicans over the swell, surfers at the break, the coast and the headland in morning light

cameras.name: marine_evening
cameras.label: The marine layer's evening fog bank rolling in at 18:30 (weather marine), from the beach town's sand looking south-west past a lifeguard tower: the wall of fog standing ~1.5 km offshore over the sea, the afterglow behind it, the sand, the tower, people leaving the beach

cameras.name: historic_core
cameras.label: Spring St in the historic core at 16:00 clear, from the west pavement at the 4th St corner looking north-east across the junction up the sunlit east-side fronts: terracotta and brick banks, their cornices, belts and arched first floors, the bronze shop frames, the street trees, traffic

cameras.name: pueblo_lane
cameras.label: PASEO DE LAS GOLONDRINAS at 12:30 clear, eye level in the east aisle under the vine pergola looking north: the puestos with their goods and papel picado, the brick paving, the adobe fronts, shoppers and vendors

cameras.name: coast_highway
cameras.label: The coast highway under the bluffs at 17:00 clear, on the seawall's apron by the open beach looking north: four lanes with traffic both ways, the beach houses on pilings over the sand, the cut bluff and the front range, the surf

cameras.name: coyote_night
cameras.label: Urban wildlife at 02:00 clear on a suburban street in the south basin, eye level in the parking lane by a parked car looking west along the north kerb: a coyote crossing under a street lamp, raccoons at the kerb carts, the dark houses with a porch light or two, the moon

cameras.name: car_park_roof
cameras.label: The roof deck of the TEMPLE GARAGE (a five-deck car park west of downtown) at 18:15 clear, eye level on the strip lane at the ramp's head, looking east-north-east: the stalls and parked cars, the light poles, the parapet, downtown's towers in the golden light behind

cameras.name: freight_trench
cameras.label: A northbound stack train in the Alameda trench at 12:00 clear, from the south edge of the Spring Blvd bridge looking south down the trench: the locomotives coming on under the bridges, the stack cars behind, the walls, drains and wall lights
